most guys buy gear for a mountain expedition they’ll never actually book. 

stop dressing for the hobby you wish you had.

the quiet guy in the room wearing a perfect heavy-weight tee. 

he’s usually the one who actually knows what he’s doing.

that feeling when you find a piece you love and immediately want to buy it in every color. 

is that smart shopping or a lack of imagination?

tried to simplify our production process this month. 

ended up adding three extra steps just to make the hem sit perfectly flat. i don't think i'll ever learn.
